parsed.summary: Implementation of PLAN-B77 is robust, well-engineered, and meets all acceptance criteria. Memory constraints on the 512MB Fly.io instance are addressed with ijson streaming for warrant contracts, chunked sector prices, RLock-based heavy job serialization with RSS tracking, malloc_trim, and SWR caching for slow endpoints. Startup crash-loop protection correctly limits catch-up attempts to 2 with backoff and skips steps that repeatedly interrupt. Minor low-severity improvements identified for timezone robustness and scheduler parameter consistency.

findings.issue: relationship daily scheduler does not specify skip_if_recent=True
findings.evidence: In server.py line 673: _rel_scheduler.add_job(lambda: _sched_heavy('relationship', ...), ...) unlike treasury, mna, and cb which pass skip_if_recent=True.
findings.suggestion: Pass skip_if_recent=True in the relationship scheduled job lambda to avoid duplicate work if a manual or startup full refresh completed within 90 minutes.

findings.issue: datetime.now() in _startup_catchup relies on host OS timezone instead of explicit Taiwan timezone
findings.evidence: In _startup_catchup (line 478): now = datetime.now() is naive system time. If the host environment defaults to UTC without TZ=Asia/Taipei, need_scan_catchup(now, ...) would evaluate hour against UTC instead of Taiwan time (UTC+8).
findings.suggestion: Use datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=8))) or ZoneInfo('Asia/Taipei') in _startup_catchup to ensure consistent Taiwan local time evaluation regardless of container host timezone.

parsed.coverage: Inspected PLAN-B77.md, jobs.py, swr.py, health.py, and server.py. Verified locking behavior in heavy(), SWR single-flight logic, catch-up and resume state machine, memory release with malloc_trim, prewarming sequence, and endpoint auth guards.
parsed.limitations: Only the 5 provided files were inspected; external modules (warrant/ingester.py, warrant/calculator.py, sector/prices.py, and dashboard.html) were reviewed indirectly based on their interfaces and test suite context.
